string.text: Atributte
Millitary Stalker
Companions Don't Die
Companions Don't Die
Enabled
A new assignment is available from ISG command. The details are classified, but the objectives are critical. Report to ISG headquarters for a full briefing.
Listen up — the Zone doesn't care about you, but I do. If you plan on hanging around these parts, you’ll be answering to me. Get over here, and I’ll lay out what you need to do.
Defend Duty Territory
Duty reports enemy activity near one of their outposts. Move in, eliminate hostile forces, and secure the position before it falls.
The commander needs reinforcement at a threatened position. Head to the marked location and assist Duty fighters in holding the line.
You successfully defended the area and helped Duty retain control. The commander acknowledges your efforts.
Capture Territory for Duty
Duty has identified an important strategic point held by enemy forces. Your mission is to assault the area and secure it for Duty.
Enemy forces are occupying ground that rightfully belongs to Duty. Push in, neutralize resistance, and secure the location.
The area has been cleared, allowing Duty forces to advance and take control. Well done.
Eliminate Priority Target
Duty has marked a high-risk hostile for termination. Find the target and eliminate them before they can cause further damage.
Обнаружен опасный человек. Задание требует скорости и точности. Выследите цель и устраните её.
The hostile target has been neutralized. Duty appreciates your efficiency.
Find Basic Toolkit
The mechanic needs a basic toolkit to continue with standard repairs. Search the Zone and bring one back.
I'm working with worn-out tools here. Bring me a basic toolkit so I can resume proper repairs.
Bring the mechanic a Basic Toolkit.
Perfect. This will help a lot — thanks.
Find Advanced Toolkit
To upgrade his workshop, the mechanic requires an advanced toolkit.
With an advanced toolkit, I’ll be able to work on more complex improvements. Bring one if you can find it.
Bring the mechanic an Advanced Toolkit.
Great — now I can start handling more serious upgrades.
Find Expert Toolkit
To perform high-end weapon and armor upgrades, the mechanic needs an expert-grade toolkit.
If you can track down an expert toolkit, I’ll be able to handle top-tier modifications.
Bring the mechanic an Expert Toolkit.
Excellent — with this, I can finally work at full capacity.
